pipelines.lead: What brings data in: each pipeline reads a source, transforms it and writes through an endpoint.
pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.empty: This project has no pipeline yet.

class.residentHelp: Runs continuously in the project's Bento runner.
class.scheduledHelp: Runs as a Kubernetes CronJob and stops between runs.
class.autoHelp: The reconciler picks: resident under 30 seconds or push-based, scheduled otherwise.

field.name: Pipeline
field.title: Title
field.classHint: auto lets the reconciler pick from the period; resident runs continuously; scheduled runs as a CronJob and needs a schedule.
field.scheduleHint: Five cron fields, such as 10 0 * * *. Required for scheduled, refused for resident.
field.periodHint: How often the source is polled, as a Bento duration: 250ms, 15s, 5m, 1h. Empty means push-based.
field.sourceHint: One input: a data source of this project, or an endpoint of the platform read by a query or a subscription trigger. Never both.
field.idsHint: URNs of the entities to read instead of the whole type; the studio fills them from the rows you tick.
field.computeHint: bloblang for reshaping, mapping for a schema-to-schema Mapping, wasm for real computation, container for heavy jobs.
field.bloblangHint: The mapping this step runs, rendered as the last processor of the stream. Leave it empty to keep the mapping in bento.yaml beside the manifest.
field.targetEndpointHint: The Endpoint URN the pipeline writes through; its Policy decides what lands.
field.allowFeedbackHint: This resident pipeline triggers itself on purpose; a person reviews the change.
field.secretsHint: References only: the name and the key of a secret, never its value. The reconciler injects it into the runner.

metrics.unavailable: No numbers: the runner is not answering.

pipelines.pauseHint: Proposes a change that stops this pipeline.
pipelines.resumeHint: Proposes a change that starts this pipeline again.

pipelines.bloblangHint: The Bloblang mapping is edited here and lands in the manifest; left empty, it stays in bento.yaml beside this manifest in the forge.
